name: What does garage interior finishing include?

mainEntity.name: What does garage interior finishing include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage interior finishing typically includes insulating walls and ceilings, installing drywall, painting, and adding flooring like epoxy or tiles. It can also involve custom storage solutions, improved lighting, and electrical upgrades to transform the space into a more functional and aesthetically pleasing area, such as a home office, gym, or additional living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage interior finishing involves insulating, drywall, painting, and flooring, plus optional storage, lighting, and electrical upgrades.
